item: row 361 group 5: the enrich and discover buttons, world discovery, gold-set save and the Diagnostics parts bar follow a language switch
summary: Settings -> Advanced -> Diagnostics: the Enrich, Fill source types and Discover buttons, the world-discovery status line, the gold-set save line and toast, the numbered-files bar and the Diagnostics build status wrote t() output (and four raw-English template lines that never translated) into ordinary nodes. They now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml (row 364): each line is a render, the button's own label comes back when its result times out, and the parts bar keeps the render it drew so the hand-over line extends it rather than reading text back. Five new keys x12, read by Plan for accuracy before the PR, each number a labelled count so no locale welds a number to a counted noun: 'Sources enriched: {n} · tags added: {tags}', 'Disabled sources added: {n}. Review them in Settings → Sources.', 'Saved · graded queries: {queries} · judgements: {judgements}', 'Saved to {path}. Judgements: {judgements} ({languages}). …' and 'Countries done: {done}/{requested} · new disabled sources: {added} · disabled sources added in total: {total}' (added_total counts the disabled sources the world job has added across runs, src/catalog/discover_job.py). The gold-set path and per-language counts are data in <bdi translate=no>, the counts read 'fr 12, de 4' instead of raw JSON; a paused world job's reason keeps the server's words through ooSaidHtml. Known and left: the build line's 'member i/N' word is still English (it needs a key) and the job's live detail is the server's text as sent. Seven lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt.
